# speex / speex_decode_fuzzer_float

speex's own fuzz target `speex_decode_fuzzer_float` ([source](source/speexdec_fuzzer.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over speex (gitlab.xiph.org/xiph/speex at a1b872e6).

speexdec-style Ogg demux + Speex header parse + speex_decode(_int)/stereo decode loop over inputs <=4096 bytes; decoded PCM, granule arithmetic results and new_frame_size are computed and discarded.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against speex at commit a1b872e6.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch speex` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `speex_decode_fuzzer_float.plain` | 144,152 | `82275a73c50e7d000c0f80be7a690236f426047f121f657c77ebb9e74ac5dbf7` |
| ubsan | `speex_decode_fuzzer_float.ubsan` | 174,120 | `d2c06d6325ea009d96b324023c01a5dd0f942e774b3eac35fe80b6bc94ec15db` |
| asan | `speex_decode_fuzzer_float.asan` | 946,792 | `01cf293ff284bbd5ce27ad96351956e9def556f6f6d55ef7bdaadfaf3c921586` |
| asan-ubsan | `speex_decode_fuzzer_float.asan-ubsan` | 981,672 | `8d46d715f2fe5af47e8b723b0ec56a7d7754837ea8d37913e0c42581f3737638` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libogg.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libogg.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libogg.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libogg.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
